notes.title: Mazey Village Demo ~ Begin your cozy adventure!
notes.content:

notes.content:

[/p][p]We’re excited to share [b]fishing[/b] in Mazey Village.[/p][p]After a long day exploring mazes and helping villagers rebuild, why not take a moment to r[b]elax by the water?[/b][/p][p]Here’s how fishing works:[/p][list][*][p][b]Cast your line[/b] into one of the many ponds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wait[/b] for something to bite...[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reel in your line[/b] before they swim away![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See how it works in the link below: [/p][previewyoutube="uJhUQ-A0H_k;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

[/p][p]See you by the pond![/p][p]~ Team Slappy Inc.[/p]

notes.title: Mazey Village ~ A Cozy New Chapter Begins!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

We are excited to share a huge update.
Our game has evolved! What started as Maze'Em, a multiplayer puzzle game, has now become Mazey Village, a cozy, story-based adventure where you’ll restore a tornado-ravaged town, explore maze-like biomes, and take on quests.

We’ve shifted our focus to single-player exploration, decorating, and storytelling, making Mazey Village the perfect home for players who love adventure and creativity. With new mechanics, cozy vibes, and a deeper connection to the world, this is the game’s biggest transformation yet!

A huge thank you to everyone who has wishlisted and supported us so far! We hope you'll continue this journey with us!

Stay tuned for more updates later! 
(Or feel free to join our discord to have a chat with us ;) [url=https://discord.gg/ux5z3ERj]https://discord.gg/ux5z3ERj[/url]) 

Yours truly,
[b]Team Slappy Inc. [/b]

notes.title: UPDATED DEMO NOW LIVE
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the release of our [b]brand-new demo for Maze'Em[/b], now available on Steam! Here's what's new:

🏜️[b] Explore New Themes[/b]
Immerse yourself in the adventure with three themes: Desert, Winter, and Grasslands. Each theme brings a unique twist to the classic maze concept, offering fresh challenges and new visuals.

🗺️[b] Discover Secrets and Quests[/b]
Uncover hidden mysteries and discover quests as you navigate through the intricate mazes. Engage with the locals who have tasks for you to complete. The demo introduces a taste of the adventure that awaits you in Maze'Em.

[b]🕹️ Singleplayer and Multiplayer Modes[/b]
Enjoy the demo at your own pace with the solo mode, where you can conquer the mazes on your own. Feeling competitive? Dive into the multiplayer mode and challenge friends or other players in a race against time and wits!

[b]👥 Join Our Community[/b]
We value your feedback and enthusiasm! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/cTBgzZDp5d]Discord [/url]community to connect with fellow players and our development team. Share your thoughts, strategies, and experiences, and let us know what you love about Maze'Em and what you'd like to see in the full version.

Have fun playing and see you in the mazes!

Team Slappy Inc.

notes.title: FIRST DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce we have released our demo for the Steam Next Fest.
In this demo, we feature 25 singleplayer levels and a working multiplayer to play with your friends online!
Try to get all 75 stars and show us your [b]a-MAZE-ing[/b] puzzle-solving skills! 

We hope you have a great time playing as much as we had a great time developing Maze'Em so far. 
New features and extra singleplayer levels will be available in the near future. 

Be sure to give us your feedback and let us know what you think!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/cTBgzZDp5d]discord [/url]and don't hesitate to talk to us about the game.
